audience_problem: A fictional adult almost folds a paper comparison above its final-cost row, then unfolds it into a useful shopping tool.

hook.text: Which number was she about to fold away?

payoff.text: match the item, check the size, then compare the total.

packaging.title: She Nearly Folded Away the Useful Number
packaging.promise: The dramatic paper reveal exposes a useful comparison criterion, not a fabricated discount.
packaging.evidence_anchor: match the item, check the size, then compare the total.

sources.claim: FTC online-shopping guidance recommends comparing item details and total cost including shipping/delivery and other fees.

retention_beats.purpose: Narration turn: The FTC recommends comparing product details and the full cost, including delivery and other fees.
Narration turn: She unfolds the page. Atomy or another shop: match the item, check the size, then compare the total.
Narration turn: The shopping guide is in the caption.

experiment.assignment_note: Three videos per variant across three topic families. Observational matched batch, not a randomized causal test.

review_scope: Packaging-to-script alignment reviewed. No claim of audience performance or automatic fact checking.
